_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Power cuts & outages
categories.description: Frequent or long cuts, blackouts, load shedding, voltage fluctuation, slow restoration.

categories.name: Bills too high or wrong
categories.description: Unexpectedly high, estimated or incorrect bills; bill shock.

categories.name: Smart & prepaid meters
categories.description: Smart meters not communicating, prepaid top-ups, faulty or fast meters.
keywords: smart meter|prepaid meter|meter reading|meter (fast|faulty|not working|running)|top ?up|in-?home display

categories.name: Tariff & unit-rate rises
categories.description: Unit-rate and standing-charge rises, price cap changes, slab rates.
keywords: tariff|unit rate|per (unit|kwh)|price cap|price (rise|increase|hike)|standing charge|slab|rate per unit

categories.name: Solar & net metering
categories.description: Rooftop solar approvals, net-meter delays, export rates, subsidy hassles.

categories.name: New connections & load changes
categories.description: Slow new connections, load enhancement, name transfers.

categories.name: Switching supplier & contracts
categories.description: Switching problems, fixed deals, exit fees, supplier failures.

categories.name: Payments, arrears & disconnection
categories.description: Disconnection threats, arrears, direct-debit hikes, refunds of credit.

categories.name: Gas, heating & LPG costs
categories.description: Gas bills, heating costs, boiler and heat-pump running costs, LPG cylinders.

categories.name: Supplier & discom support
keywords: customer (service|care|support)|complain|complaint|ombudsman|helpline|contact number|no response|call (center|centre)|toll free|\b1912\b|problems? today|not working|back ?billing|bill download

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Homeowner
personas.description: Owns their home; pays bills directly.

personas.name: Renter
personas.description: Rents; landlord controls meter or supplier.

personas.name: Prepaid / low-income household
personas.description: Pays as you go, sensitive to price rises.
keywords: prepaid|pay as you go|can'?t afford|struggling to pay|benefits
